title: PrestaShop stock restrictions drop products without stock
evidence: Product::sqlStock applied stock attribute and shop restrictions in WHERE when called with a query builder. The fix put the restrictions into the LEFT JOIN condition in the stock SQL used by the cart and new-product queries.
adaptation: The replay keeps the stock join and the zero-attribute branch, using one synthetic shop. It omits the separate shop and product filters, other product joins, table prefixes, and projections unrelated to the row loss.
before_sql: SELECT p.id_product AS id FROM product p LEFT JOIN stock_available stock ON stock.id_product = p.id_product WHERE stock.id_product_attribute = 0
after_sql: SELECT p.id_product AS id FROM product p LEFT JOIN stock_available stock ON stock.id_product = p.id_product AND stock.id_product_attribute = 0
